messages:
Priya: Thinking about cohortized extraction: split runtime into 3 cohorts (high-SLA, bulk-low-cost, batch-embeddings). Idea is to group by latency sensitivity + tenant compliance needs. sketching a phased plan.
Alex: SGTM. Quick Q — KV cache ownership? duplication will blow cost for hot prompts.
Priya: Agree. Plan is a single tenant-aware cache service with read API initially, write handoff later. proxy-read to avoid duplication.
Ken: DB coupling is my worry. sessions + checkpoints live in monolith DB. How do we migrate without downtime?
Priya: Phases: 1) read-only facade + shadow writes to new store, 2) cut write path for low-risk tenants, 3) migrate sensitive tenants once KMS/audit are in place. Rollback path keeps monolith as fallback.
Sam: +1. Canary by tenant cohort + feature-flag per-tenant. automatic fallback if P95 or error rate spikes.
Maya: Observability must be first. Need per-tenant P90/P95 latency, KV hit rate, token cost delta, and request traces. No cut until dashboards exist.
Alex: Also add contract tests for streaming & function-calling surface. We'll need deterministic replay fixtures.
Priya: Minimal API contract: keep same HTTP surface and headers. New optional header `X-Redwood-Cohort` to opt-in routing. Backward-compatible defaults.
Sam: Rough rollout snippet:
```sh
# phase 1: feature-flag small cohort
rb feature-flag set cohort_extract=true --tenants=@small-group
rb deploy --canary
```
Ken: Good. Who owns migration tickets and the epic?
Priya: I'll own the epic and split into tech-debt slices: storage, cache, routing, contracts, ops. Action items: Priya to draft RFC by EOD, Alex to enumerate contract tests, Maya to sketch dashboards and alert thresholds, Sam to prototype flag+canary flow.
Priya: Also propose a hard deadline for tech-debt paydown on the old monolith paths (60 days after phase 3) so we don't re-accumulate.
Sam: Add a quick rollback CLI step we can run during canary that flips routing back to monolith. Keep it <30s.
Alex: Noted. I'll add contract test checklist to the ticket.
Maya: I'll add SLOs and alert playbooks to the ops ticket.
Priya: thanks all — will post RFC link when ready. @channel :rocket: :wrench:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded for commit abc123 on small-group cohort :white_check_mark:
